questions.q: What is an algorithm, according to the overview?
a: A series of steps to solve a specific problem
questions.why: The overview compares it to a recipe.

questions.q: Which sort works by dividing into piles and sorting the piles?
questions.why: Lesson 1 describes merge sort this way.

questions.q: How does Earliest Due Date work?
a: Start with the task due next
questions.why: Lesson 2 says sort tasks by deadline.

questions.q: What does Shortest Processing Time suggest with many small tasks?
a: Knock out the shortest ones first

questions.q: What does the prisoner's dilemma illustrate?
a: Game theory about decisions based on others' choices
questions.why: Lesson 3 uses it as a classic game theory example.
